note: v488: Reconciliation accuracy. A purchase dated at the end of a month but posted by the bank a day or two later no longer makes its own month fail — the app checks the neighbouring statements and shows "cleared on the next statement" instead of "missing", and pulling a month now fixes the previous month's mark for you. Manual matches and unlinks follow the actual bank line instead of its position in the list, so a transaction that posts late can't quietly re-point them at a different charge. Your reconciliation history and month marks save one month at a time, so working on two devices can't overwrite each other. Matching is also faster on a large ledger.
